transcript.text: hotpoint SA2 oven not heatin on fan, grill ok. wat does SA2 mean??

SA2 is the first part of Hotpoint's model code, indicating the product range your oven belongs to. On its own it doesn't pin down the exact model or which parts it uses; that depends on the full model number, which normally has further numbers and letters after SA2. From what you have described, the most likely cause is fan / rear ring element [fan-oven mode]. Set it to 180°C on the fan function for 15 minutes. Is it heating up properly now, or still not?
no still not heatin on fan, the fan at the back isnt spinning just a low hum. grill still works tho
Next: A visibly split/blistered element can be identified by eye (power off). Let me know what you find.
ok ive turned the oven off at the cooker switch. not sure what a split element would look like tbh, cant tell. the fan not spinning is the main thing, just humming. what should i check?

[Heading: Likely cause: fan motor]
The checks point to the fan motor. I could not find a confirmed match for model SA2 in our parts catalogue, so check with the manufacturer or a parts supplier using the full model number, or ask an appliance engineer to fit it.
